title: Red On Black
symptom: During low blood sugar warnings, red text on black background is extremely difficult to read. User has tried changing color settings but the red text seems preset.
cause: The thread identifies that dark red on black has no significant contrast, making it hard to read regardless of vision.
fix: As a workaround, change the background color from black to gray via Settings -> xDrip+ Display Settings -> xDrip+ Color Settings, specifically the 'Main Chart Background' color. Also, enable the Extra Alerts (xDrip+) alarm to get an alarm when predicted glucose drops below the Low value, and assign a specific sound clip to the alarm to avoid needing to read the text.
evidence_quote: But, it is possible to change the background color. If you change the background color from black to gray, you may get better contrast. You can change colors: Settings -> xDrip+ Display Settings -> xDrip+ Color Settings The background color is "Main Chart Background".
